What will you do?

As a TIG Welder, you will work closely with a small and experienced team to build high-quality stainless steel filter systems.

Your responsibilities include:

- TIG welding of stainless steel components (RVS/INOX)
- Assembling parts based on technical drawings
- Welding both precision components and larger constructions
- Checking dimensions and product quality
- Contributing ideas for technical improvements and solutions
- Helping build complete filtration systems from start to finish

- Experience as a TIG Welder
- Experience with stainless steel (preferred)
- Ability to read technical drawings
- Good communication skills in English, German, or Dutch
- Eye for detail and quality
- Motivated and reliable attitude

Are you looking for an active warehouse job that fits perfectly with your personal life? Then this is your chance! We are currently looking for motivated order pickers and packers who can start immediately and are available for both morning and afternoon shifts. Using modern tools such as hand scanners and voice picking, you will collect orders quickly and accurately. You make sure every order is complete and ready for shipment.

In this role, you will stay active throughout the day and play an important part in keeping the logistics process running smoothly.

Working hours (2 shift system):

- Morning: 07:00 – 16:00
- Afternoon: 16:00 – 00:00

- You speak English or Dutch
- You are available at least 2 days per week
- You are willing to work in a 2 shift system
- You are physically able to perform active work (standing, walking, lifting)
- No experience is required, motivation are most important
- Resident of the Netherlands
- Valid work permit for the Netherlands required
- No housing available

As a logistics employee, you handle incoming and outgoing goods every day. You unpack and check products, and prepare them for shipment. You also ensure the warehouse remains tidy and organized. You work with scanners and sometimes a forklift. Working hours are flexible, and you can work either full-time or part-time. Together with your colleagues, you ensure that customers receive their orders on time.

You are someone who likes to roll up their sleeves and enjoys working as part of a team. You value completing tasks neatly and on time. You are capable of working accurately and have no trouble standing or walking during your shift. You have a reasonable command of spoken and written English, enabling effective communication within the team. Logistics experience is a plus but not a requirement—you are a quick learner! You live within 20 kilometers of Lelystad.

Mandatory requirements:

- You have at least a VMBO level of education/aptitude
- You speak and write English
- You live within 20 km of Lelystad

As a warehouse employee at DHL, you help sort parcels and make sure each parcel ends up in the right place. Thanks to your work, parcels are sorted on time and delivered to customers.

You can start by placing parcels onto the conveyor belt so they can be sorted, or by taking sorted parcels off the belt and placing them in a roll cage. Later, DHL gives you the opportunity to learn and carry out other tasks in the warehouse.

Please note: parcels can weigh up to 25 kg. Most parcels are lighter, but heavier parcels sometimes occur. You always lift these together with a colleague.

Working Hours

- Day shift: 08:00–16:00
- Evening shift: 16:00–00:00
- Intermediate shift: 18:00–02:00
- Night shift: 00:00–08:00

You can work across a maximum of two different shifts.

- You are available at least 3 to 4 days per week.
- You can lift parcels weighing up to 25 kg, with a colleague’s help for heavier parcels.
- You have your own transport (car, bicycle or scooter), or you live within walking distance of the sorting centre.
- You speak Dutch or English so you can communicate effectively with your team.
- You are at least 18 years old.
- You live in or around Dordrecht, Rotterdam, Schiedam or Capelle aan den IJssel.

Do you want to start as soon as possible at one of the biggest logistic companies in the world? Don't look any further!
As a Warehouse Worker at GXO in Rijsbergen, you’ll have a job with impact, earning a great salary right away while enjoying a fantastic work atmosphere.

You will be working in a brand-new warehouse where job satisfaction is the top priority. Here you work in two shifts. That means: a nice shift allowance + never being stuck in traffic again! Sounds like the perfect deal, right? Sounds like the perfect deal, right?

What we offer
- A good salary starting with € 14,71 + allowance!
- Access to more than 1000 online training courses!
- Work full-time in 2 shifts!
- Good chance on a long term contract!
- Work in a new, but very warm and friendly team!
- Work in a brand-new warehouse!

Who you are
You are a real go-getter who is physically fit and loves to stay active. It's also important that you:

- Speak Dutch or English well
- Have your own transport to get to Rijsbergen
- Are available full-time to work in two shifts
- Can apply for a VOG
- Are able work a physical job where you have to stand and bend down sometimes

What will you do
Imagine this: you walk into GXO and greet your friendly colleagues with a high-five 🖐️. As a warehouse employee, your day starts in the morning or afternoon, depending on your shift. You scan incoming goods, check that everything is correct, and ensure that every package ends up in the right place on the shelves. You won't need the gym anymore, because you'll be nice and active all day long! In between, you chat with your teammates during your break in the modern canteen. After 8 hours of work, your day is over, and you drive home feeling satisfied. As a warehouse employee, you are a very important link in the logistics process! 🚛

- Preparing the warehouse for new incoming goods by labeling the paths
- Scanning and checking incoming goods
- Preparing orders for shipment to customers
- Loading and unloading trucks

Rather than simply solving the immediate issue, you look for the underlying cause and consider how similar problems can be prevented in the future. Because you will work closely with internal and external customers, colleagues, and suppliers, clear communication is essential. You are able to explain technical issues in an understandable way and understand the importance of good service. Practical knowledge of electrical, mechanical, and pneumatic systems. Ability to read and

interpret electrical circuit diagrams and technical assembly drawings. Demonstrated experience with troubleshooting and fault finding. Experience with preventive and corrective maintenance. Experience with predictive maintenance and/or automated systems is an advantage. Strong awareness of safety and quality standards. Good command of Dutch and English, both written and spoken. Wat bieden wij je? As a Service Technician at ASML, you will work in a highly automated and technologically advanced environment where you can further develop your technical expertise. You will have the opportunity to work with complex equipment, learn from experienced colleagues, and build a long-term career within one of the world's leading high-tech companies. You can expect: A gross monthly salary of €4,220, excluding shift allowance. 25.1% shift allowance for all hours worked in a two-shift schedule. A 13th-month salary. An annual bonus based on company results. 27 days of paid annual leave. Long-term career and development opportunities. The opportunity to work with advanced automated systems in a high-tech environment. Be Part of the Impact ASML develops and manufactures the world's most advanced lithography systems. These systems are essential for producing the microchips that power modern technology. Behind this highly complex production process is a sophisticated logistics operation that ensures the right components and materials are available at the right place and at the right time. As a Service Technician, you are an essential part of that operation. By keeping automated warehouse systems and intralogistics equipment running reliably, you directly contribute to the continuity of ASML's production process. Your work may happen behind the scenes, but its impact is significant: you help keep the technology of tomorrow moving today. Are you looking for a production job in Gouda? As a Production Worker, you help keep the production process running smoothly. Together with your team, you work on cutting, packing, filling and labeling food products. You start with a salary from €14.71 per hour, work 36 hours per week, and there is free parking available at the location.

This is a practical job where you see the results of your work immediately.

At the start of your shift, you check the production line with your team. Once everything is ready, the production process begins. You help keep the line running and make sure products are processed correctly. Together with your colleagues, you make sure everything runs smoothly.

Your tasks include:

- Working on a production line with about 5 colleagues
- Cutting, filling, packing and labeling food products
- Keeping the workplace clean and organized
- Performing quality checks during production
- Reporting small issues or deviations to the operator

You play an important role in the production process.

Working in a production environment requires teamwork, accuracy and a practical mindset. This role suits someone who enjoys hands-on work and working together with colleagues.

Requirements:

- MBO working and thinking level
- English and/or Dutch language skills
- Accurate and motivated work attitude

Preferred:

- Experience in production or factory work
- Ability to work in a busy production environment
- Attention to safety and hygiene

Do you already have experience in an operator role, for example through an internship or previous job? Then this is your chance to grow! Through Manpower, you will work as a part-time or full-time operator for one of our clients in the Venlo region. In this role, you are the hub of the production process: you operate machines, monitor processes, and keep everything well organized with the associated administrative tasks. Does this sound like your next step? Don't wait any longer and apply today!

The exact work depends on which employer you will be working for, but during a working day you may be involved in:

    - Operating and monitoring machines and production processes
    
- Monitoring quality and safety in the production environment
    
- Performing first-line inspections and resolving minor malfunctions
    
- Recording production data and maintaining clear production and maintenance administration

What’s in it for you

    - Gross salary of €2,700 to €3,500 per month (indicative, depending on experience and employer)
    
- Shift allowance (when working in shifts)
    
- Part-time and full-time opportunities
    
- Travel allowance according to the client’s policy
    
- Pension accrual through Manpower
    
- Plenty of opportunities to further develop yourself in the production and operator sector
    
- Free access to the Manpower Academy e-learning platform

    - Minimum MBO working and thinking level, preferably in engineering, production, or logistics
    
- VAPRO A and B certification is a major advantage
    
- Experience in a production or operator role is an advantage
    
- Good command of the Dutch and English languages, both spoken and written, for understanding work instructions
    
- Availability of at least 32 hours per week
    
- Accurate, responsible, and team-oriented working attitude
